- Timing: customer needs formal offer by COB Thursday 11/4 to route through procurement for an 11/9 sign-off

Jordan —

Thanks for the context. Approveable with guardrails.

Internal approval: up to $20,000 in one-time credits without additional sign-off. We can stretch to $25,000 if the following are met:

- Deal must be captured as DEAL-4382 in HubSpot and include the 12-month PO commitment line item
- Customer agrees to a 90-day credit expiration and consumption reporting to the AM
- Legal signs the standard MSD and Procurement sends a PO or countersigned SOW by 2027-11-09

Please complete the credit approval form (attached) and route to finance for tracking. Once that's in, send the formal offer to the customer and loop me if procurement pushes back.

Ethan / Sarah —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. As discussed with my team, Redwood can provide a one-time usage credit to help bridge your pilot-to-production ramp and extend the evaluation window. Summary of the formal offer (aligned with our internal approvals):

- One-time credit: $25,000 applied to hosted usage invoices; valid for consumption within 90 days of the start date
- Trial extension: service access extended to 2028-02-28 for the pilot tenant
- Condition: Customer executes Redwood Master Services Agreement (standard terms) and provides a 12-month PO to be activated when you move to production
- Expiration of offer: this credit will be available if the signed agreement or PO is received by 2027-11-09

I attached an updated quote (quote_QH_v2.pdf) with line items showing the credit and the expected monthly spend profile after conversion. If that looks okay, I can prepare a DocuSign for the MSD + SOW and route the PO instructions for your procurement team.

Next steps:
1) Confirm you accept the offer by replying to this thread
2) I’ll send the DocuSign bundle and the PO template for your procurement
3) Once signed, finance will apply the credit and we’ll update your account license window

Link to draft quote: https://drive.redwood.com/quotes/DEAL-4382/quote_v2.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if you’d prefer to run procurement together.

Best,
